metadata.title: आदिवासियों का रानी काजल धाम | Rani Kajal Dham of MP adivasi | Mathwad village | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Rani Kajal temple is located atop the Vindhyachal hills in Madhya Pradesh. It holds significance as a place of worship for the Bhil tribe. During your recent visit, you had the opportunity to explore this temple. From the hill's summit, you were able to enjoy breathtaking views of the lush green hills and a lake formed by the backwaters of the Narmada River.

It sounds like a serene and picturesque location, with cultural and natural beauty coming together to create a memorable experience for visitors.
